result.label: the Cauldron
result.description: A low, wet-black forest standing in permanent dusk over ground that breathes. The light never changes and casts nothing you could call a shadow; trunks weep a grey metallic sweat that hardens into scabs and crystal fans. Nearly everything alive here is either sealed against the vented metal-rich gas or has processed the load and become toxic itself -- and nothing is fast, because a chemosynthetic budget is thin. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: raven nettle
result.description: A jet-black nettle, its stalks bristling with fine barbed hairs that catch on cloth and skin and let go of neither. It grows in thick clumps and hides the ground under it. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: blood bouquet
result.description: Dark crimson flower heads bunched on a single stalk like a grim bouquet, heavy and wet-looking even when the air is dry. It gets its colour from the same iron the trees sweat, and nothing that eats it eats twice. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: crystal flower
result.description: A flower whose petals have crystallized into sharp, faceted, translucent shards. The forest's metal-laden sweat wicks up the stem and comes out the other end as glass. It chimes faintly when the fog moves through it, and it will open a hand that grabs it carelessly. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: giant toxic flower
result.description: An oversized flower with lurid toxic-green petals that ooze faint venomous droplets. It grows alone, fed by whatever dies beneath it, and it is exactly as poisonous as it looks. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: vent
result.description: A fissured throat in the ground ringed with bone-white mineral terracing laid down one exhale at a time. It breathes the forest's metal-laden gas in a slow, heavy rhythm. The breath thickens in a vent bloom, thins in vapour and dew, and goes silent just before a bloom arrives. A vexxiss will brace over one and drink until it falls quiet for days. Flowers ring a vent according to its temper. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: suush
result.description: A translucent globe drifting a few feet off the ground, lit faintly from within by whatever it has most recently digested. A curtain of long, fine gathering tentacles hangs beneath it, combing the roiling gas for the chemistry it lives on. It never comes down, never attacks, and never seems to notice you. It is also, entirely, a bag of the same volatile vapor the Cauldron breathes -- and pays no mind at all to what happens if something punctures it. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes

result.label: vexxiss
result.description: The ground here talks all day -- rush and groan and gurgle, the slow engine of the forest's chemistry -- and the vexxiss is the one thing that walks like it belongs in the machine. A hill of slag that moves: plates of smelter-scab and old bark grown together, crystal fans standing down the spine like vents on a boiler, no eyes anywhere on it because it has never needed to see anything. It drinks the ground's breath straight from the wellheads, it hates fire the way a lung hates smoke, and the crews that shear its plates say the trick is not the climbing. The trick is doing it without warming the shears. RimMandrake: Baroque Biomes
